title: Authorization Decision Contract
summary: Return deny-by-default authorization decisions from scoped RBAC, ReBAC and ABAC policy input; identity management is excluded.

criteria: AuthorizationRequest subject, tenant, channel/app, action, resource and context fields plus scoped RBAC, ReBAC and ABAC policy input are human-approved.

risks.desc: Missing, unknown or incomplete policy input could accidentally become allow and create OWASP Broken Access Control exposure.
risks.mitigation: Require default-deny, deny-overrides and missing/unknown/incomplete negative assertions before human-approved implementation.

risks.desc: Subject, resource or context mismatch could authorize access across tenant boundaries.
risks.mitigation: Bind every request and audit field to one tenant and require Tenant A/B negative fixtures with redacted reasons.

risks.desc: Decision context or auditFields could retain unnecessary PII or leak policy internals.
risks.mitigation: Require data classification, purpose-limited retention, redaction, deletion or anonymization and named human approval.

risks.desc: A planning decision contract could be misread as identity, policy-authoring, PEP runtime or admin-override authority.
risks.mitigation: Keep exclusions and NO-GO explicit; reject implementation, readiness, release and deploy claims without new human authority.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: Tenant isolation is fail-closed: cross-tenant subject, resource or context mismatch returns deny and a redacted audit reason.
Deny-overrides prevents a lower-priority allow from relaxing an explicit deny; absent or unknown policy input never becomes implicit allow.
Human approval is required before any policy or authorization behavior is implemented or activated; this node grants no apply authority.

items: Planned positive cases cover scoped RBAC, ReBAC and ABAC allow and deny decisions with exact reason, policyRef and auditFields.
Planned negatives cover missing, unknown and incomplete inputs, cross-tenant/context mismatch, explicit deny-overrides, stale policy and spoofed context.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP Broken Access Control risk is modeled through unknown permission, missing guard, cross-tenant resource access and client-supplied allow attempts; input validation is mandatory.
Every boundary validates tenant and context consistency and returns default-deny without leaking PII or policy internals in reason text.
Auditability requires immutable correlation, subject reference, tenant, action, resource reference, reason, policyRef and decision timestamps with retention controls.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: App and module consumers submit the typed authorization request and consume the decision; they cannot recompute, relax or persist policy locally.
A consumer must preserve tenant, channel/app, action, resource and context scope when forwarding the decision to a separately owned PEP.
Identity/authentication/SSO lifecycle, policy authoring/storage/UI and admin override remain separate authorities for every consumer.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: subject and resource references, context attributes and auditFields require PII/data classification, purpose, owner and retention approval before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.
Decision audit retention is purpose-limited; expiry, deletion or anonymization and legal-hold exceptions are planned without storing raw sensitive context by default.
policyRef and correlation evidence stay reviewable while secrets, credentials and unnecessary PII are redacted; no audit store is created here.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO and error-budget metrics include allow/deny/default-deny counts, cross-tenant/context mismatch rejects, reason-code distribution and evaluation latency by tenant-safe labels.
Logs and traces carry correlation, decision, reason, policyRef and policy version with PII redaction; high-cardinality subject/resource values are not metric labels.
Alerts cover any cross-tenant allow, default-allow regression, audit-field omission and performance-budget breach; thresholds require human approval.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The primary failure mode is missing policy data, unknown fields, dependency outage, stale cache or incomplete context; it degrades to deny and never to a default role or allow.
The same versioned request and policy snapshot must produce a deterministic decision; retry and idempotency controls cannot change audit semantics or duplicate side effects.
Policy-version change invalidates cached decisions; rollback preserves deny behavior and audit review without claiming a runtime mechanism exists.
